ruleDefinitions.name: Fsutil Suspicious Invocation
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects suspicious parameters of fsutil (deleting USN journal, configuring it with small size, etc).
Might be used by ransomwares during the attack (seen by NotPetya and others).

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\fsutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "fsutil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*deletejournal.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*createjournal.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*setZeroData.*")))
